scripts.build: cd ../teams && pnpm build && rm -rf .next/standalone/.next/static .next/standalone/public && cp -R .next/static .next/standalone/.next/static && { [ -d public ] && cp -R public .next/standalone/public || true; } && find .next/standalone -type l ! -exec test -e {} \; -print -delete
